## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated (unit and/or e2e)
- [ ] `pnpm build`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test`, `pnpm docs:build`, `pnpm docs:demos` and `pnpm e2e` pass
- [ ] User-facing changes are described above, for the changelog
- [ ] Public API changes: JSDoc updated, `pnpm docs:reference` run and the docs page updated
- [ ] New behavior is opt-in, or the breaking change is called out
- [ ] Any third-party material has a compatible license and is listed in `NOTICE`
